scope: Shared phase frontend accuracy and cost; original pilots and three trained networks retained
search_queries: Newtonized orthogonal matching pursuit multiple measurement vectors frequency estimation CFAR NOMP
LEO satellite grant free random access joint Doppler synchronization channel estimation low complexity phase estimation
site.arxiv.org AFDM carrier frequency offset estimation low complexity synchronization
selection: Primary author papers with readable algorithm/model text; classical estimation plus directly related satellite/AFDM work; not an exhaustive systematic review

sources.title: Variable Projection for Nonlinear Least Squares Problems
sources.application: Existing gain elimination is already variable projection; general linear-gain elimination supports a multipath extension, not a guarantee of improved phase accuracy.

sources.title: Newtonized Orthogonal Matching Pursuit for Line Spectrum Estimation with Multiple Measurement Vectors
sources.location: Section III-A equations (5)-(10); Section III-B Algorithm 1; Section IV-A
sources.application: Coarse detection, Newton refinement, cyclic refinement and gain refit; AFDM delay/Doppler atoms and candidate budgeting require a separate adaptation.

sources.title: LEO Satellite-Enabled Random Access with Large Differential Delay and Doppler Shift
sources.application: Posterior second-moment phase update; original independent unit-modulus phases differ from the project constraint exp(j q beta). Existing project adaptation did not uniformly improve AER/NMSE.

sources.title: Time and Frequency Offset Estimation and Intercarrier Interference Cancellation for AFDM Systems
sources.application: CPP-correlation joint/stepwise ML. Needs time-domain prefix observations and a single-link CFO model; not a direct replacement for the current per-user mixed observations.

sources.title: An Enhanced MNOMP for Line Spectrum Estimation and Detection
sources.application: 2026 preprint distinguishes continuous-search and discrete-grid GLRT thresholds; its CFAR threshold is not calibrated for the AFDM user/path dictionary.

recommendation_order: Avoid unused derivatives and repeated fixed transforms; preserve existing search and objective
Evaluate local refinement from prior sweep with explicit global-search fallback, shared for all methods
Evaluate limited multipath fitting with common per-user Doppler only if phase error still limits performance
